frontier: The native host checkpoint includes an integer annihilator witness for a restricted invariant-support family, but automatic recognition, useful cost-aware selection and numerical support preservation remain unproved and unbenchmarked.
next_action: After the exact Driver review and antecedent gates, freeze a no-pruning support observer, reuse an integer-kernel/subgroup algorithm, and compare its complete detection-and-selection cost with the existing dense fallback.
research_value: Test the precise surviving opportunity suggested by sustained sparse support, while preventing special examples, standard sparse convolution or tolerance-based pruning from being mislabeled as a general new solver.

dependencies.required_artifact: A current terminal Driver review of host and independent-verification evidence explicitly permitting this restricted successor scope.
An accepted source-backed comparison covering integer-kernel/subgroup support recognition, invariant Fourier subspaces and cost-aware sparse/dense selection, with an exact residual claim boundary.

successor_gate.new_information_gap: The host experiment shows benefits for invariant-support examples, but no reusable exact-support recognizer, cost-aware selector or robust fallback contract has been established.
successor_gate.why_parent_result_does_not_close_it: The parent implements and compares an exact sparse/FFT callback; it does not prove that automatic algebraic support detection is useful after its own cost, floating off-support components and stress cases are included.
discriminating_outcomes: Exact arithmetic invariant-support certificate plus a host selector with restricted-family total-cost benefit and honest generic fallback.
A scoped no-go showing detector/maintenance cost, floating leakage or rapid support growth defeats the proposed advantage.
successor_gate.kill_condition: Reject any mechanism that discards tiny nonzero modes without a separate error account, changes pressure output, or fails matched-accuracy total-cost and held-out checks.
successor_gate.alternative_route_or_free_exploration_co: Retain the existing dense FFT path and close the selector hypothesis if it has no discriminating advantage. Standard integer-kernel/subgroup algorithms must be reused or explicitly compared; the separate rounding/cancellation/ROM tasks remain alternatives.
successor_gate.why_new_stage_or_task_is_better_than_sam: A separately blocked bounded hypothesis can be rejected independently without reopening completed host integration or diluting the independent-review gate.
